description: Step 2 of sending money: executes a preview_payout quote and sends real funds from your balance — irreversible once sent. destination_network and destination_address must be the ones of the preview. idempotency_key is required: reuse the same key when retrying after a timeout so the payout is never sent twice. Then follow get_payout (status until completed or failed, transaction_url) or webhooks payout.completed / payout.failed.

destination_memo.description: Memo/tag when the destination needs one (exchanges, XRP, TON…).

external_id.description: Your own reference (order id); unique per account.

idempotency_key.description: Required. Your unique key of this payout; the same key never sends twice.

name: create_payout
title: Send a payout (irreversible)
